title: Google is rolling out Gemini to cars that have Google built-in, replacing Google Assistant, starting with English in the US (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Google is rolling out Gemini to cars that have Google built-in, replacing Google Assistant, starting with English in the US — The current Google Assistant is being replaced with a smarter, more conversational upgrade. … Google is preparing to update vehicles that have Google built-in with its Gemini AI assistant.
